{{Short description|Spanish physicist (1939–2022)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2023}}
'''Antonio Fernández-Rañada Menéndez de Luarca''' (1939 – 19 May 2022) was a Spanish theoretical physicist.<ref>{{cite news|author=Rojo, Miguel|date=19 May 2022|location=Gijón, Asturias|newspaper=El Comercio|title=Fallece el gran físico asturiano Antonio Fernández-Rañada (The great Asturian physicist Antonio Fernández-Ramada dies)|url=https://www.elcomercio.es/sociedad/fallece-gran-fisico-asturiano-antonio-fernandez-ranada-20220519140136-nt.html?ref=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F}}</ref>

==Biography==
Antonio Fernández-Ramada was born in [[Bilbao]]. Soon after his birth, his family moved to [[Oviedo]], where he spent his childhood and youth until he began his university studies in Madrid. He graduated in physics with a [[Licentiate (degree)|licentiate]] from the [[Complutense University of Madrid]].<ref>{{cite news|author=Nómbela, César|title=Eminent professor and humanist scientist|date=20 May 2022 |newspaper=ABC (national edition)|location=Madrid|page=50}}</ref> In 1965 he graduated with a [[PhD]] from the [[University of Paris]] with a thesis on causality and the [[S-matrix]]. In 1967 he defended his [[habilitation]] thesis ''Propiedades analítica en la difusión pión-nucleón'' (Analytic properties in pion-nucleon diffusion) at the Complutense University of Madrid.<ref name=Ruiz>{{cite book|editor=Ruiz, Guiomar|chapter=Antonio Fernández-Rañada, Epílogo, Los protagonistas|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QG2k7ZDX6GEC&pg=PA69|pages=69–70| isbn=9788499205519 | title=La aventura del descubrimiento | date=September 2011 | publisher=Encuentro }}</ref>

He was employed at the ''[[Centro de Investigaciones Energéticas, Medioambientales y Tecnológicas]]'' (CIEMAT), formerly named the ''Junta de Energia Nuclear'' (Nuclear Energy Board). He taught [[quantum mechanics]] at the [[University of Barcelona]] and [[theoretical physics]] at the Complutense University of Madrid. He was appointed [[University Professor|professor]] by the [[Universidad de Zaragoza]] and held the chair of [[electromagnetism]] at the Complutense University of Madrid.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lne.es/siglo-xxi/2009/06/07/memorias-antonio-fernandez-ranada-menendez-luarca/765115.html|title=Memorias de Antonio Fernandez-Rañada Menéndez de Luarca|website=La Nueva España|date=7 June 2009}}</ref>

Fernánez-Rañada was the director of the ''Grupo Interuniversitario de Física Teóretica'' (GIFT). He was the founding editor and editor-in-chief for ten years of the journal ''Revista Española de Física''.<ref name=Ruiz/>

He did research on the physics of [[elementary particle]]s, nonlinear dynamics, topics in mathematical physics, the relation between topology and [[quantum electrodynamics]], and some problems in cosmology. He also published articles on how science is related other fields of knowledge and to societal issues. He was the author of the 1990 book ''Dinámica clásica'' (Classical dynamics), a coauthor of the 1997 book  ''100 problemas de la Mecánica'' (100 problems of mechanics), and a coauthor of the 2-volume, 2007 book ''Física básica'' (Basic physics). He also wrote expository works on science and its wider implications:<ref name=Ruiz/> ''Los científicos y Dios'',<ref>{{cite book|title=Los cientificos y Dios (summary in Spanish)|website=Trotta Editorial (publisher's website)|url=https://www.trotta.es/libros/los-cientificos-y-dios/9788481649635/}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Scientists and God|postscript=; translation of ''Los Cientificos y Dios''|isbn=978-1477572504 |last1=Fernandez-Ranada |first1=Antonio |date=6 September 2012 |publisher=CreateSpace Independent Publishing Platform }}</ref> ''Los muchos rostros de la ciencia'', ''De la agresión a la guerra nuclear'' — coauthored with J. Martín-Ramírez, ''Heisenberg. Ciencia, incertidumbre y conciencia'',<ref name=Ruiz/> and ''Breves apuntes sobre la comunicación de la ciencia''.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Fernández-Rañada, A.|year=2003|title=Breves apuntes sobre la comunicación de la ciencia|journal=Física y Sociedad|volume=14|pages=4–7|url=https://www.divulgameteo.es/uploads/Comunicación-Rañada.pdf}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
{{more citations needed|section|date=August 2023}}
* Research Prize in Physics from the [[Spanish Royal Academy of Sciences]] (1997)
* Medal of the [[Spanish Royal Physics Society]] (1985)
* Jovellanos International Essay Award (1994) for ''Los Muchos Rostros de la Ciencia''<ref>{{cite book|title=Los Muchos Rostros de la Ciecia|author=Fernández-Rañada, Antonio|year=1995|publisher=Ediciones Nobel|postscript=; Premio Internacional de Ensayo Jovellanos|url=https://www.gbv.de/dms/goettingen/218708084.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=S4S5CgAAQBAJ| title=Los muchos rostros de la ciencia | isbn=9788484597209 | last1=Fernández-Rañada | first1=Antonio | date=27 August 2015 | publisher=Ediciones Nóbel, S.A. }}</ref>
* Silver Medal of the Prince of Asturias (1999)<ref>{{cite web|title=Antonio Fernández-Rañada, member of PUGWASH, passes away|website=CICA International|date=27 May 2022|url=https://cicainternational.org/cica-international/antonio-fernandez-ranada-member-of-pugwash-passes-away/}}</ref>
* President of the Principality of Asturias Council of Arts and Sciences
* President of the [[Spanish Royal Physics Society]] (2005-2010)
* Member of the Council of the [[European Physical Society]]
* Member of the Jury of the Princess of Asturias Award for Scientific and Technical Research
